errors: pending unauthorized duplicate was prematurely classified as superseded
expected: the new duplicate waits for its request-specific rejection and fails at the active-binding authorization gate
actual: the reader saw the still-current old attempt pointer before its new request was processed and raised AdmissionSupersededError
root_cause: current-pointer actor/attempt mismatch was treated as proof that the polling request had previously been admitted, although it also represents an ordinary not-yet-processed replacement request
remediation: treat a mismatched current binding as pending in the initial admission polling boundary; the post-admission stale writer is fenced by its already captured ContributorFence
